as_told.title: 1995 black mailbox footage of an orange wobbling disc

plain: This is a story about a home video tape said to show a glowing orange disc near Rachel, Nevada, a tiny town close to Area 51, a secret US military base. A UFO documentary filmmaker, James Fox, describes the tape, which he credits to a local man named Chuck Clark, and says the footage shows an orange disc-shaped thing just wobbling in the sky. If real, it would be film of an unknown craft near one of America's most secret bases. A second teller, a man named Logan who appeared on the podcast of a host, Jesse Michels, tells it differently. He says the footage, supposedly authentic, was shot by two college kids on a trip to Area 51, around 1995, and places it at a well-known spot called the black mailbox rather than in Rachel itself.
